text: Redraw requests accumulate instead of collapsing. `Changed()` adds 1 (`third_party/nucular/masterwindow.go:146-148`), and the poller removes only 1 per 20 ms tick (`shiny.go:257-260`). `post()` calls `Changed()` per callback (`internal/ui/app.go:267-275`), `transcriptLayout` once per pending block per pass (`transcript.go:311-319`), and the Rally debounce every frame (`rally.go:158-162`). After streaming or opening a long chat, the window keeps doing 50 Hz full passes for seconds or minutes. Make `changed` a flag (`max(cur,1)`).
note: Changed is an atomic coalesced flag; follow-latest uses measured content extent rather than an enormous invalid scroll value. third_party/nucular/masterwindow.go, internal/ui/chat.go.

text: Replace polling with event-driven wakeups. The updater sleeps 20 ms per loop (`shiny.go:210-279`), adding 0–20 ms of input latency and 50 wakeups/s per idle window. It forces an update every 10 ms while any mouse button is held (`shiny.go:263-272`), and `ebitenscreen` adds a 30 Hz ticker (`screen.go:80-99`). Use a wake channel signalled by `Changed()` and input.
note: Nucular waits on Changed/input wakeups instead of its 20 ms polling loop; held-input repeat uses a bounded timer and shutdown wakes/exits cleanly. The Ebitengine adapter event pump and native input latency work remain. third_party/nucular/masterwindow.go, shiny.go.

text: Every input event runs two full UI passes because nucular sets `changed=2`. Use one pass and trigger the second only when layout changed (for example the `trashFrame` case).
note: The second layout pass remains; no evidence from this patch proves all two-pass cases can be removed safely.

text: "Follow latest" sets `Scrollbar.Y = 100000000` (`chat.go:777-779`). nucular clamps it and sets `trashFrame` (`nucular.go:640-648`), so every following chat renders twice per frame: 8.9 ms and 26 MB versus 4.3 ms and 13 MB measured at 200 blocks. Set it to content height minus viewport height.
note: Changed is an atomic coalesced flag; follow-latest uses measured content extent rather than an enormous invalid scroll value. third_party/nucular/masterwindow.go, internal/ui/chat.go.

text: Any change repaints the whole window and copies the frame twice. Detection is all-or-nothing (`masterwindow.go:200-239`); `Upload` copies into a second CPU buffer (`screen.go:114-123`), and `WritePixels` uploads the full texture (`screen.go:318-321`). Compute a damage rectangle from changed commands, redraw under that clip, upload a sub-image, and swap buffers instead of copying.
note: Command damage includes old/new bounds and changed clipping, redraws under that clip, and copies/uploads only the damaged rectangle. Partial redraws match full redraws pixel-for-pixel over deterministic and randomized translucent scenes. The adapter keeps synchronized reusable staging storage rather than swapping a buffer still owned by the rasterizer; it no longer performs full-frame copies for small changes. third_party/nucular/damage.go, shiny.go, internal/windowing/surface.go, internal/ebitenscreen/screen.go.

text: Replace the 10 s forced redraw ticker (`app.go:236-246`) with a timer that fires only when something time-based is visible (relative times, polling terminals).
note: Removed the unconditional 10-second redraw goroutine. A timer is armed only for an active Rally view or visible conversation information with time-dependent content; event and notice wakeups are independent. internal/ui/account.go, app.go.

text: Replace busy-wait debounces with `time.AfterFunc`, starting with the Rally search debounce that redraws every frame for 300 ms (`rally.go:152-163`).
note: Rally search uses a cancellable AfterFunc timer with generation/signature checks, stopped on close; no redraw loop is needed for debounce. internal/ui/rally.go, lifecycle.go.

text: Text wrapping rasterizes glyphs only to measure them: `textClamp` calls `Glyph()` instead of `GlyphAdvance()` (`third_party/nucular/font.go:113-125`). It sits under `WrapText`, which runs every frame for labels, Markdown and card titles.
note: Measurement uses GlyphAdvance, binary-search ellipsizing and cached run advances for hit tests. third_party/nucular/font.go; internal/ui/{widgets,transcript}.go.

text: `ellipsize` trims one rune at a time and re-measures each prefix (`widgets.go:23-37`; about 22 µs cold per label), flooding the 2048-entry width cache. Binary-search the cut point and memoize by (string, width, face).
note: Measurement uses GlyphAdvance, binary-search ellipsizing and cached run advances for hit tests. third_party/nucular/font.go; internal/ui/{widgets,transcript}.go.

text: `transcriptHit` re-measures every prefix on each drag move (`transcript.go:64-83`), which is quadratic. Accumulate per-character advances once per line.
note: Measurement uses GlyphAdvance, binary-search ellipsizing and cached run advances for hit tests. third_party/nucular/font.go; internal/ui/{widgets,transcript}.go.

text: Layout workers create a fresh font face per job (`transcript.go:98`), so every measurement misses the cache. They also evict the UI's entries and hold the global `widthMu` lock (`font.go:37-72`). Give each worker a long-lived face and its own cache.
note: Layout jobs reuse pooled measurement faces; full separation of shared width-cache ownership remains.

text: Resize allocates new full-frame CPU buffers and a GPU image per size step (`screen.go:118-120,311-316`, `shiny.go:244-249`). Grow geometrically and reuse.
note: Raster, staging and GPU surfaces use shared geometric capacity buckets, reuse storage during small size changes and release allocations when the requested area falls below one quarter of retained capacity. Visible bounds remain distinct from allocated capacity. Headless resize/copy-coordinate tests and pure-Go platform builds pass. third_party/nucular/internal/windowing/surface.go, shiny.go, internal/ebitenscreen/screen.go.

text: Rounded rects and circles allocate a new rasterizer after each clip change (`shiny.go:402-422`). Cache pre-rendered corner masks per radius. Low priority.
note: Rounded corners and ellipses use per-window cached alpha masks keyed by geometry. The cache retains at most 16 masks and 1 MiB; oversized shapes use the vector fallback. Pixel-equivalence and bounded-cache regressions pass. third_party/nucular/shape_masks.go, shiny.go.

text: Coalesce streaming deltas.
